deliverables: Custodial wallet onboarding and self-custody export flow
Organizer dashboard and support verification tools
Independent third-party smart-contract security audit with remediation report
Public launch campaign and trade-show activations
Public metrics dashboard and quarterly reporting
Revenue-share repayment mechanism to the Cardano Treasury
request.recipient: Anvil Development Agency, Inc. / Intersect as budget administrator through the TRSC/PSSC framework
request.what: Fund Phase 2 of a production Cardano-native ticketing platform operated by Sellout.io and built by Anvil Development Agency, including secondary marketplace, royalty enforcement, anti-scalping controls, wallet onboarding, organizer tools, audit, and launch campaign.

claims.claim: Phase 1 of the ticketing platform is already live on Cardano mainnet with on-chain event creation, CIP-68 ticket minting, transfers, and attendance verification.
Sellout funded Phase 1 entirely from its own capital with over $130,000 invested.
The proposal requests 4,969,231 ada, stated as approximately $1,093,231 at $0.22 per ADA, over 8 months with milestone-gated disbursement.

Phase 2 is expected to deliver 200+ events on-chain, 75,000+ CIP-68 NFT tickets, 150,000+ on-chain interactions, $6,000,000+ ticket revenue on-chain, and 20,000+ new wallets within 12 months from launch.
The Yellowstone Club 2026 concert series is presented as a contracted anchor deployment projected to move more than $6,000,000 through Cardano in Year 1.
The proposers commit to repay $1,093,231 to the Cardano Treasury through a revenue-share mechanism using 25% of fees until full reimbursement and 5% thereafter.
The revenue-share base definition and cadence are not finalized in the anchor and are deferred to M1 contracting with the appointed oversight committee.
The budget includes a detailed capital allocation table for labor, development, marketing, audit, infrastructure, contingency, legal formation, and Intersect administration fees.
Intersect is stated to administer the funds through the Sundae Labs TRSC/PSSC framework with a six-party external oversight committee and public dashboard tracking.
Anvil and Sellout state that they have not received ada from the Cardano Treasury within the last 24 months.

summary: The document asks for 4,969,231 ada to fund an 8-month Phase 2 buildout of a Cardano-native ticketing marketplace, with milestone-gated delivery, Intersect/TRSC-PSSC administration, a proposed revenue-share repayment obligation, and adoption targets tied to Sellout users and the Yellowstone Club 2026 deployment.
